target_customer: Creators, editors, agencies and teams who want AI agents to edit video
problem: Video editing is manual; Palmier Pro lets coding style agents such as Claude, Codex or Cursor operate a timeline through an MCP server while humans finish the cut.
business_model: Free open source editor with paid plans for AI generation credits and a managed per video service

founders.name: Marcos Rico Peng
education: UC Berkeley, graduated in three years
founders.background_notes: YC page says he documents training as a professional swimmer on YouTube with over 155k subscribers.

technical_complexity.rationale: A native macOS editor with timeline, export codecs and an MCP interface is substantial for two engineers, though built on existing model APIs.

defensibility.rationale: Open source GPL code and rapid copying by Descript, Runway and OpusClip MCP connectors make the editor easy to match.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: These vendors later added agents or MCP connectors per 2026 roundups; no acquisition of Palmier found.

market_need_then: At batch time (S24) the company reportedly built an AI that understands codebases, per YC launch listings, so the video need is a later pivot thesis. No dated demand evidence for video was found.

branding.domain_note: Uses palmier.io; another earlier Palmier product exists from the same company.

identity.logo: not described by any source found
identity.voice_and_tone: confident and playful, informal with emoji

branding.brand_signature: The video editor built for AI
branding.community_and_virality: Show HN launch reportedly reached about 113 points (aggregator mirror, unverified) and a Hacker News trend on 2026-07-24 per one article; founder has a swimming YouTube audience of 155k per YC page.

brand_strength.rationale: Open source launch drew Hacker News and blog attention, but the brand is young and reuses a name from an earlier product.

pivots.from: Palmier, AI that understands any codebase (YC launch listing)
pivots.to: Palmier Pro, AI native video editor

outcome_analysis: Palmier is active with two founders and no verified funding. After a codebase understanding product it launched Palmier Pro in mid 2026, an open source Mac editor for AI agents, claiming over 100K downloads on its site. Incumbent editors are adding agent features, so traction and monetization remain unproven.
notes: Funding search found no round. Outcome search found no acquisition, shutdown or layoffs. Launch dates for Palmier Pro vary across aggregators (June 2026). The 100K+ downloads figure is a company claim. Competitor search returned only 2026 roundups so the dated list is empty. Name origin not found.
